thread:
hana: hi team — Hana here (joined eng-platform). Im setting up a private deployment for a customer demo and need to know who approves KMS/HSM key access, SOC2 checklist signoff, and who to loop for on-prem deploy perms. first demo is next Tues so want the fastest path.
jamie (People Ops): welcome @hana! :tada: People Ops coordinates the paperwork but legal/security own SOC2 signoff. i can help expedite once engineers file the infra requests.
leo (security): security owns KMS/HSM provisioning and key policies. for private deployments we require a security review + attestation. open a ticket in #help with subject "kms-request: <name>" including customer name, key use, and TTL. for demo scope we can issue a temporary key (short TTL) if legal okays it.
tess (platform): platform handles the private-deploy role bindings and deploy tokens for redwood-private clusters. DM me repo + cluster id and ill pre-stage access. if infra needs an SSH jumpbox we coordinate with @owen.
owen (private-delivery): i own on-prem deploy playbooks and network checklist. for customer demos we have a fast-track path: 1) ticket to #help, 2) attach SOC2-lite signed by legal, 3) page private-delivery P2. email private-delivery@redwood.ai if it's customer-facing and CC your manager.
maria (legal): legal checks SLA/contract constraints for keys and data residency. i can sign the demo-level attestation if People Ops flags it as demo-priority. send me the customer name + data residency needs.
hana: can someone paste tiny ticket snippets i can copy?
leo (security): KMS ticket snippet:
```
Subject: kms-request: hana
- Customer: AcmeCorp (demo)
- Key use: encrypt model artifacts + telemetry
- TTL: 72h (demo)
- Data residency: eu-west-1
- Manager: Priya (eng-platform)
```
owen (private-delivery): Private deploy snippet:
```
Subject: private-deploy: hana
- Cluster: acme-demo-cluster (onprem)
- Required: deployer role, jumpbox ssh access
- Network: VLAN 30, allowed IPs: 198.51.100.0/24
- Purpose: customer demo 2026-04-07
- Manager: Priya (eng-platform)
```
onboard-bot: Request queued (id:onb-2215002479). You will be updated in this thread.
hana: thanks all — filing now. tagging @jamie to help route legal signoff if needed. if anything blocks the customer demo ill page private-delivery P0 and CC security + legal.
